accounting.cpu: Editor-side Z80 instructions/T-states; fake BDOS cycles excluded.
accounting.copies: LDI/LDD/LDIR/LDDR source reads inside text arena; may include save-record packing. Other text reads are scalar/scan activity.
accounting.setup: Entry, initial gap seeding, cursor placement and fixture layout outside command measurement; setup costs separately recorded.
accounting.warm: Raw per-key columns retained; sums include all100 redraws; stack field is maximum, not sum.
accounting.invariance: Read-only operations assert unchanged gap bounds AND zero arena writes; save can copy text to DMA without relocating gap.
accounting.equivalence: Logical state/screen/file digests compared at each stage and every warm key against both frozen artifacts.
accounting.hostLatency: Not measured; no keystroke wall latency inferred.
